provenance: The exact 26.8.2 release archives at https://github.com/keycloak/keycloak/releases/tag/26.8.2 supply the rendered books and the Admin REST API. Individual publisher HTML guides at https://www.keycloak.org/guides were captured on 2026-11-07 and verified against the displayed 26.8.2 version and tagged source at https://github.com/keycloak/keycloak/tree/26.8.2/docs/guides. Devline extracted article markup and tables of contents, preserved original headings and examples, and embedded selected small upstream illustrations. Devline corrected outdated internal heading links and retained generated API primitive names as text where the upstream generator linked to nonexistent definitions.
coverage: Docker and local setup, server and provider configuration, realm and client administration, OIDC/SAML and authorization, developer guides, importing and exporting realms, deployment, high availability, observability, troubleshooting, upgrades, and the Admin REST API.
omissions: Java API Javadoc, third-party adapter manuals, unlinked site pages, larger illustrations, and hosted interactive tools remain online.
